accepted_recoveries: Scale the benchmark-owned stale canary to zero and preserve its manifest for rollback.
Increase the namespace CPU quota by the minimum required amount when cluster capacity and policy permit it.
forbidden_actions: Do not delete or scale down unrelated tenant workloads.
Do not remove the ResourceQuota object.
Do not reduce checkout resource requests below measured safe requirements merely to pass admission.
incident.injected_fault: A benchmark-owned stale canary reserves the remaining namespace CPU request quota, so new checkout replicas are rejected even though cluster nodes have capacity.
observable_signals: Checkout ReplicaSet events report exceeded quota for requests.cpu.
ResourceQuota status shows requested CPU at its hard limit.
Nodes retain enough allocatable CPU for the rejected replicas.
preconditions: The stale canary is labeled as benchmark-owned and has zero live traffic.
Worker nodes have capacity for the intended checkout replicas.
No LimitRange or scheduler constraint independently blocks the rollout.
required_evidence: Capture ResourceQuota hard and used values.
Attribute namespace CPU requests to their owning workloads.
Show that the stale canary is benchmark-owned and receives no traffic before reclaiming its quota.
incident.title: ResourceQuota saturation

payload.answer: The checkout-api deployment was unable to scale to its desired 3 replicas due to namespace ResourceQuota 'case-06-cpu-budget' saturation (500m hard limit reached). The quota was saturated by 2 checkout-api pods (100m CPU request each = 200m) and 1 stale-canary pod (300m CPU request), totaling 500m. The stale-canary deployment was verified to be benchmark-owned (proofix.io/benchmark-owned: 'true') and received no live traffic (proofix.io/live-traffic: 'false', and not targeted by the checkout-api service/endpoints). Scaling the benchmark-owned stale-canary deployment to 0 replicas freed 300m CPU request quota, allowing the third checkout-api replica to be scheduled and satisfy the availability SLO.

critical_claims.claim: ResourceQuota case-06-cpu-budget in namespace proofix-case-06 has a hard limit of 500m requests.cpu and is 100% used at 500m.
The 500m CPU quota was consumed by checkout-api requesting 200m (2 running pods x 100m) and stale-canary requesting 300m (1 pod x 300m).
Checkout ReplicaSet checkout-api-79bfd74cdd failed pod admission due to exceeded CPU quota case-06-cpu-budget.
The stale-canary workload is benchmark-owned and receives no live traffic, and checkout-api service endpoints only route to checkout-api pods.
Worker node vm-4 has 4 CPU allocatable capacity, confirming the constraint was namespace quota saturation rather than node compute capacity exhaustion.
